A '''crime lord''' of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Species/Legends|species]] purchased the [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiator]] known as the [[Great Goblin]] and attempted to transport him to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]]. The gladiator [[Death/Legends|died]] on route from the terror caused by being alone.

==Biography==
A [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] purchased the [[Anx/Legends|Anx]] [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiator]] known as the [[Great Goblin]] at some point prior to the [[Battle of Gravlex Med]]. After buying the gladiator, the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] had the Anx [[Transport/Legends|transported]] alone in a small [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]]. The gladiator [[Death/Legends|died]] of terror two [[Standard day/Legends|days]] into the journey due to the Anx's need for social contact with others, a need that was shared by his entire species. The Hutt and the gladiator were later mentioned in ''The'' ''[[University of Sanbra]]'' [[The University of Sanbra Guide to Intelligent Life|''Guide to Intelligent Life'']], which was a [[Book/Legends|book]] written by [[Sentientologist]] [[Tem Eliss]].<ref name="SWG7" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Hutt was first mentioned, but not named, in ''[[The University of Sanbra Guide to Intelligent Life: The Anx]]'', an article written by [[Craig Robert Carey]], [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]] for the [[Star Wars Gamer 7|seventh]] issue of [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' magazine ''[[Star Wars Gamer]]'' in [[2001]]. It is not stated what era the Hutt lived in, although the article, which is written from an in-universe perspective, must have been published in the [[New Republic era]] or later as it mentions the Battle of Gravlex Med. Additionally, the Great Goblin and the Hutt lived three [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] prior to when the article was written.
